FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 240
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Pebblin W. Warren
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 03/06/2026
House Bill 240 as introduced would appropriate $16,300,159 from the Education Trust Fund to
Tuskegee University for Fiscal Year 2027. In addition, this act requires at least $2,000,000 this
appropriation to be expended for the agricultural research and extension service state match.
